findings.evidence: Lines 198–212 use only the additive equivalence, scalar multiplication, `algebraMap`, and the preceding `baseRingToFunctionField` API, all already defined under `[CommRing k]`.
findings.fix: State this section with `[CommRing k]`; downstream function-field results can continue specializing it to fields.
findings.issue: `globalRationalFunctionsEquivFunctionField` and its apply lemma assume `[Field k]`, although their construction uses only the existing commutative-ring algebra structures.

findings.evidence: Lines 55 and 197 explicitly construct `⟨⟨Classical.choice inferInstance, trivial⟩⟩` from the existing assumptions; the public assumptions at lines 62 and 218 therefore add avoidable caller obligations.
findings.fix: Construct the top-open `Nonempty` instance inside each lemma and remove it from the public signatures.
findings.issue: Both new apply lemmas require `[Nonempty (⊤ : X.Opens)]` even though `[IsIntegral X]` already supplies a point from which this instance can be constructed, as their definitions do internally.

summary: The global-rational-functions equivalence is unnecessarily restricted and exposes redundant nonemptiness assumptions.
